tools.name: financials_as_of
tools.description: A company's 10-K/10-Q/20-F/40-F filings (newest accepted first, up to 40) with revenue, profit, EPS, cash, debt, cash flow and margins as each filing first reported them, EDGAR acceptance time and filing link. as_of = only filings accepted by then.

tools.name: snapshot_as_of
tools.description: For up to 10 tickers, the newest filing EDGAR had accepted by as_of, with key metrics as first reported.

tools.name: metric_history
tools.description: One metric per period, newest first: value as first reported (and when), latest value known at as_of, restated flag.
